kjv: Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.

lines.say: Carrying something heavy to bed tonight? Put it down.
lines.big: Carrying something heavy to bed tonight

lines.say: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved. Psalm fifty five, verse twenty two.

lines.say: Cast it, don't carry it. He said he'd hold you up.

lines.say: Lord, I'm casting this burden on you tonight. Sustain me. In Jesus' name, amen.
